messages:
Alex: heads-up — just got a support escalation from Acme. they want partial fncall streaming + structured output guaranteed for hosted API, and they expect an SLA (p50 < 50ms tail) for dedicated customers. copying note from the ticket below.

Sam - Support: paste from ticket: "Customer running real-time chat assistants. They need partial function call frames emitted as soon as available so downstream services can start processing. Example: send first chunk of args as soon as parsed. Current behavior waits for full output; causes 200-400ms added latency."

Sam - Support: example request snippet they attached:
```json
{"model": "redwood-embed-1", "stream": true, "functions": [ ... ], "response_format": "json_lines"}
```

Maria (PM): thanks. key asks: 1) partial fncall emit hook, 2) stable structured output framing (json-lines or chunked records), 3) SLA ask for dedicated customers only (but customer wants parity on hosted if feasible).

Jordan (Eng): high-level constraints: our streaming runtime batches and prefers producing full tokens for safety. emitting partial fncall frames is possible but has a perf tradeoff: smaller batches, more RPCs, higher GPU overhead. we can mitigate with a low-latency fast-path but needs runtime change + api contract for incremental fncall deltas.

Alex: Acme is on a paid Dedicated plan and pushing for timeline — they said a POC in 6 weeks would be ideal. if we treat this as enterprise uplift, could be committed.

Maria (PM): options for triage: a) ship minimal API surface: `partial_fncall: true` opt-in flag for Dedicated only, docs + canary — medium effort; b) full parity for hosted (larger scope) — high effort; c) product workaround: offer webhooks that accept full outputs but with pre-processing — low effort but not ideal. need to pick.

Jordan (Eng): rough dev estimates: option a ~3w eng + 1w infra/testing; option b ~8-12w + infra changes; option c ~1w (support + docs).

Sam - Support: Acme impact: blocks latency-sensitive payment flows. they indicated willingness to sign a 12mo commitment for Dedicated if we commit to option a and SLA. also 2 other customers asked about similar behavior but not blocking.

Maria (PM): proposed prioritization: treat as P1 for Dedicated roadmap (option a) and P3 for hosted parity. Launch criteria for option a: \n- feature flag opt-in available in Dedicated\n- smoke tests for partial frame correctness on representative models\n- monitoring for partial-frame rate + errors\n- documented API examples and migration guidance\n- legal/SLA language drafted

Jordan (Eng): acceptance tests: unit-level streaming harness, e2e with a small model that emits function calls, perf regression <5% for other workloads, and no increase in 95th token latency >10ms for general customers.

Alex: ok to proceed with PM spec + eng estimate? I can take owner on customer side and push contract.

Maria (PM): yes — I'll create a short PRD and add prioritization matrix. adding risk notes: "Possible perf regression under mixed workloads; needs canary gating and quick rollback."

Sam - Support: I'll notify Acme and ask for official business case + signature to lock timeline.

Jordan (Eng): ask to product: is the SLA threshold strictly numeric (p50 <50ms) or percentage-based? we need clear SLI.

Maria (PM): SLA to propose: 99th percentile of partial-frame emit latency < 60ms for Dedicated when under committed capacity. we can negotiate exact numbers in the contract.

Alex: +1 on 99p proposal. also require escalation path and playbook.

ticket-bot: Ticket #C-84321 updated: customer commitment received? NO. Attachments: sample payloads.

Maria (PM): next steps: 1) Maria to open PRD + add to Dedicated sprint board (owner: Maria) 2) Jordan to scope engineering tasks and spike fast-path (owner: Jordan) 3) Alex to secure customer commitment 4) Sam to keep ticket warm and gather examples. will reconvene EOW. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Eng): noted. I’ll spin up a 3-day spike to validate feasibility and report back by +72h.

Sam - Support: sharing that customer said they can start POC in staging next week if we have opt-in flag.

Maria (PM): ok — moving to P1 Dedicated backlog. tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.

Alex: thanks team.
